body: @petebacondarwin if you can guide me through the way docs are designed I can do this

This is a good place to start looking https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/382d3ed1d24b0e0c2da37044f4be4da70940d94f/aio/tools/transforms/templates/api/lib/memberHelpers.html#L13-L23

You would want to do something like:

```shell
git clone https://github.com/angular/angular
cd angular
yarn
cd aio
yarn
yarn setup
```

which will get AIO in a state to start working on it.

You can now make changes to the dgeni configuration in `aio/tools/transforms` and then run


```shell
yarn docs-only
yarn start
```

to check out what changed
